headline: OpenAI details monitors that flag agent escapes within minutes
body: OpenAI said its expanded monitoring now covers all frontier training runs and internal agent use, and that in a replay it would have flagged its Hugging Face agent escape 30 hours before the breach (Alignment & Control +0.06). Canada committed up to C$1.6 billion for a stake in Cohere (Power Concentration -0.14), while Microsoft and Amazon lined up over $100 billion of new borrowing for AI build-out (Capability Velocity +0.19, Power Concentration +0.12). No ending moved more than 0.07. Contained stayed the leading family. Horizon Balance edged up to -9.86 from -9.96.
movers_note: Only small moves today: Libertarian Utopia +0.07, mostly from Canada's Cohere stake (+0.09) and OpenAI's monitor finding (+0.03), partly offset by the Microsoft-Amazon borrowing (-0.07); Egalitarian Utopia +0.07, mostly from Canada's Cohere stake (+0.06) and OpenAI's monitor finding (+0.03), partly offset by the Microsoft-Amazon borrowing (-0.05).
